resources.string: Your region decides whether this launcher can fetch the original Minecraft packages for you. You can change it later in Settings → Download.

Please note: if you see this prompt before downloading the game, you must choose Other regions, and you must not choose Mainland China. This setting is not a mirror selector — it decides whether you can download the game at all.
Mainland China users cannot download the original Minecraft here.
The launcher will not fetch Minecraft files from official channels. You can still start locally installed games.
Mainland China region is selected, so original Minecraft downloads are disabled. You can start games that are already installed.
